pages.text: Wizards and mages are the backbone of your settlement.
$(bold)Right-click$() a mage to open their equipment panel (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, wand).$(br2)Click the backpack icon on the model preview to view their inventory.
pages.title: Interaction & Equipment

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Follow Mode$(): The mage follows you as a combat bodyguard and pauses town jobs.$(li)$(bold)Peace Mode$(): The mage will not attack creatures and focuses purely on production.$(li)$(bold)Tactics$(): Open $(l:wandscape:reference/strategy_guide)Spell Tactics$(/l) to configure battle skill triggers.$(li)$(bold)Dismiss$(): Terminate the contract; the mage permanently departs.
pages.title: Operating Modes
